usage: cox lake [-h] {sync} ...

The Iceberg lake: sync the run store and traces into it. Needs the optional extra `lake`.

positional arguments:
  {sync}
    sync      append new run-store rows and register new trace files; --dry-run writes nothing

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit

examples:
  cox lake sync
  cox lake sync --dry-run --json
